creator: Sharks, Lee
description: Reproducibility package for a cross-implementation test of deletion semantics: a remember/0.2 producer bundle, an independently built assertion-consistency checker, and a 111-case conformance corpus built before either. Establishes that a recorded removal and a never-landed write are observationally identical at the consumer boundary, and that exposing the absence assertion on a machine-readable discovery surface is necessary and sufficient to separate them. v1.1 (2026-09-03) adds run 08: the producer's own repair, shipped at 55e6493, read live with no translation layer — separability holds, the absences map is necessary, the reconciliation key distinguishes empty from unexamined; one new finding, the two maps key the same identity in two forms. v1.2 (2026-09-05) adds run 09: the key-form repair at 3806111 read live — one identifier form, every value carries it, exclusivity holds over stated ids with no normalisation; the producer's own 2026-09-01 audit is recorded as having normalised silently.
context: knowledge-catalog#207; fulfils the cross-test offered there
